title: Return to a draft or submitted response

returnToDraft.heading: Return to a draft response
returnToDraft.intro: You can return to a draft response by using:
returnToDraft.bullet1: the account details you used when you started the response
returnToDraft.bullet2: your save and return number, for example A7F9-K3P2

returnToSubmitted.heading: Return to a submitted response
returnToSubmitted.intro: You can return to a submitted response by:
returnToSubmitted.bullet1: using the account details you used when you submitted the response
returnToSubmitted.bullet2: creating an account. You can only access responses where the case number starts with 6 or 8.

mainQuestion.question: What type of response do you want to return to?
mainQuestion.option1: I want to return to a draft response
mainQuestion.option2: I want to access or return to a submitted response

draftOption.question: How do you want to access the response?
draftOption.option1: I have an Employment Tribunal account
draftOption.option2: I have a save and return number

submittedOption.question: How do you want to access the response?
submittedOption.option1: I have an Employment Tribunal account
submittedOption.option2: I have a response but no Employment Tribunal account
submittedOption.supportingText: You will be able to create an account and access the response if the case number starts with a 6 or 8.

returnToExisting.required: Select how you want to access the response
